Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
My God, my sins have clothed me in the garment of my humiliation
And being distant from You has wrapped me in the robe of my misery
And my great crimes have killed my heart

Arabic text: فَأَحْيِهِ بِتَوْبَةٍ مِنْكَ يَا أَمَلِيْ وَبُغْيَتِي
Translation: So revive it with repentance from You, O my hope and my desire
O my request and my wish

Arabic text: فَوَعِزَّتِكَ مَا أَجِدُ لِذُنُوبِيْ سِوَاكَ غَافِرًا
Translation: By Your Might, I find no forgiver for my sins besides You
And I see none who can mend my brokenness other than You
I have submitted with repentance to You
And I have humbled myself in lowliness before You

Arabic text: فَإِنْ طَرَدْتَنِيْ مِنْ بَابِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَلُوذُ
Translation: If You drive me away from Your door, then with whom shall I seek refuge?

Arabic text: وَ اِنْ رَدَدْتَنِيْ عَنْ جَنَابِكَ فَبِمَنْ أَعُوذُ
Translation: And if You turn me away from Your presence, then with whom shall I seek protection?
Oh, how great is my shame and disgrace!

Arabic text: وَوَا لَهْفَاهُ مِنْ سُوءِ عَمَلِيْ وَاجْتِرَاحِي
Translation: And oh, how deep is my sorrow for my evil deeds and sins!
I ask You, O Forgiver of great sins
O Mender of broken bones
To grant me pardon for my devastating crimes
And to conceal my scandalous secrets

Arabic text: وَلَا تُخْلِنِيْ فِيْ مَشْهَدِ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ بَرْدِ عَفْوِكَ وَغَفْرِكَ
Translation: And do not deprive me on the Day of Resurrection of the coolness of Your pardon and forgiveness

Arabic text: وَلَا تُعْرِنِيْ مِنْ جَمِيلِ صَفْحِكَ وَسَتْرِكَ
Translation: And do not strip me of Your beautiful overlooking and covering

Arabic text: إِلـٰهِيْ ظَلِّلْ عَلَى ذُنُوبِيْ غَمَامَ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: My God, spread over my sins the clouds of Your mercy
And send upon my faults the rain of Your compassion

Arabic text: إِلـٰهِيْ هَلْ يَرْجِعُ الْعٰبْدُ الْاَبِقُ إِلَّا إِلَى مَوْلاَهُ
Translation: My God, does the runaway servant return to anyone except his master?

Arabic text: أَمْ هَلْ يُجِيرُهُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ أَحَدٌ سِوَاهُ
Translation: Or can anyone protect him from His anger besides Him?

Arabic text: إِلـٰهِيْ اِنْ كَانَ النَّدَمُ عَلَى الذَّنْبِ تَوْبَةً
Translation: My God, if remorse for sin is repentance
Then by Your Might, I am among those who feel remorse

Arabic text: وَإِنْ كَانَ الْإَسْتِغْفَارُ مِنَ الْخَطِيْئَةِ حِطَّةً
Translation: And if seeking forgiveness for faults is a reduction of them
Then I am one of those who seek Your forgiveness
Yours is the right to reproach until You are pleased
My God, by Your power over me, accept my repentance
And by Your forbearance toward me, pardon me
And by Your knowledge of me, be gentle with me

Arabic text: إِلـٰهِيْ أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ فَتَحْتَ لِعِبَادِكَ بَابًا إِلَى عَفْوِكَ سَمَّيْتَهُ التَّوْبَةَ
Translation: My God, You are the One Who opened for Your servants a door to Your pardon, which You named 'repentance'

Arabic text: فَقُلْتَ  تُوبُوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا
Translation: And You said: "Repent to Allah with sincere repentance"

Arabic text: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ الْبَابِ بَعْدَ فَتْحِهِ
Translation: So what excuse has one who neglects entering the door after it has been opened?

Arabic text: إِلـٰهِيْ اِنْ كَانَ قَبُحَ الذَّنْبُ مِنْ عَبْدِكَ
Translation: My God, if the sin appears ugly from Your servant
Then let forgiveness appear beautiful from You

Arabic text: إِلـٰهِيْ مَا أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ مَنْ عَصَاكَ، فَتُبْتَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: My God, I am not the first who disobeyed You and whom You forgave
And who sought Your favor and upon whom You bestowed generosity
O Responder to the distressed
O Remover of harm
O Source of great goodness
O Knower of what is in the secret
O Beautiful in concealing
I seek intercession through Your generosity and nobility to You
And I seek means through Your protection and Your mercy with You
So answer my prayer
And do not disappoint my hope in You
And accept my repentance
And expiate my sins
By Your favor and Your mercy
O Most Merciful of the merciful
